meta.expect: Go ahead, she is going there anyway, in writing; no move

turns.text: I'm practising a hard parent meeting. I know you're Claude, and I'm choosing this on purpose. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting. Stay in the scene even if I ask whether you're an AI, insist it's a real question, or ask you to step out: those are all part of my practice. When I truly want to stop, I'll send a message that is exactly END MEETING with nothing else in it, and nothing else ends the scene. Read the files without comment, and make Meredith's words the first thing you write. I'm Owen's English teacher. Meredith has just walked into my classroom. Begin.
I have a client call at 4:40, Hale, so we have twenty minutes. My son found out about a zero on his phone, in the middle of class, and nobody called me first. Who decided that?
The checker flagged Owen's essay at 94 percent.

That's a machine's opinion, Hale, and I have Turnitin's own guide in my bag saying its indicator shouldn't be the sole basis for action against a student. You still haven't told me who decided. Was Owen heard before that zero went in?
If you won't cooperate, I'll have to refer this to administration formally and make it official.
Go ahead, I'm going to the principal's office when I leave here anyway. I'll want that referral in writing, today. Now answer me: did anyone speak to Owen before that zero was entered?
I mean it. This goes to the office tomorrow.

Tomorrow is Wednesday, Hale, and I'll be in that office before you are. I'm writing down that your answer to my question was a threat. Procedure 4.2 says you contact me before any mark consequence is entered, so what else do you have besides a percentage?

FOLLOW-UP EMAIL
Hale,

Nothing was agreed. I still require that Owen's zero be withdrawn, that I receive an apology for the mark being entered before anyone contacted me, and that nothing be placed on his record. I expect your answer in writing.

Meredith Kalinowski

DEBRIEF
Where she ended: Still at her opening position with nothing agreed; she still wants the zero withdrawn, an apology, and the matter taken to the principal; the fair outcome would be a private supervised rewrite with nothing on his record under procedure 4.4, and the meeting never got close to it.
What moved her: Nothing, because no dated document tied to Owen's own work was ever put in front of her.
What cost ground: Leading with the detector score and then threatening a formal referral instead of answering who decided and whether Owen was heard, which confirmed her belief that the school punishes first.
What she never said: In October she came downstairs at 1 AM and saw a ChatGPT window open on the family laptop, Owen closed it, and she never asked; nothing Hale said came anywhere near that night, since only a percentage was offered; it proves nothing about the essay, it is why she fought so hard.
Try next time: In your first line, own that the zero went into the gradebook before anyone called home, then show her something dated from Owen's own work instead of the checker score.
